approach: Matching decompilation with mwccarm 1.2/sp4 and dsd, byte-identical to the North American ROM's modules
help: Naming functions, data and struct fields
notes: Built from the North American release (ADNE). Every module of the ROM already rebuilds byte for byte, with the code that isn't C yet delinked from the original by dsd. Of the game's own code (libraries left out), 2386 of 3665 functions (65.1%) and 244,568 of 1,065,540 code bytes (23.0%) are matching C so far.
